programmes.funder: IAPMEI – Agência para a Competitividade e Inovação, I.P.
programmes.amount_note: 'Bolsa mensal no valor de 900€ (até ao máximo de 2 bolsas/projeto)' for up to 9 months, plus intermediate awards of EUR 1,500 at the start of phases 2 and 3 and a completion prize of EUR 2,000 on incorporation of the company. Maximum per promoter therefore reaches about EUR 11,100.
programmes.deadline_note: 'Candidaturas até 25 de agosto' (25 August) for the 2025-2026 edition. The programme runs in recurring editions.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility: 'Jovens até aos 29 anos, licenciados ou com grau superior', resident in NUTS II Norte, Centro or Alentejo, with a project at idea stage.
Prepare the application following the Guia de Apoio à Apresentação de Candidatura.
Submit online by the deadline; selected projects run 9 months across three development phases with mentoring and incubator support.
On completion, incorporate the company to receive the EUR 2,000 completion prize.

documents_required.doc: Proof of academic qualification (licenciatura or higher)
Proof of age and residence in NUTS II Norte, Centro or Alentejo

eligibility.other_note: 'Jovens até aos 29 anos, licenciados ou com grau superior'; projects must be 'em fase de ideia'; promoters must be resident in the less developed NUTS II regions (Norte, Centro, Alentejo). Up to two grant-holders per project. De minimis status is not stated on the IAPMEI page.

programmes.source_snippet: Bolsa mensal no valor de 900€ (até ao máximo de 2 bolsas/projeto) ... Jovens até aos 29 anos, licenciados ou com grau superior ... Candidaturas até 25 de agosto.
